## About
Afesa Construction is a family-owned home restoration and repair company. We specialize in the installation of siding, windows, gutters, soffit and fascia, and we partner with some of the best suppliers in the market so the work holds up and looks right.
We've built our name through referrals and satisfied customers. Reviewers talk about Abraham and his team showing up on time, answering questions and keeping the work area clean. One homeowner had rotting cedar siding replaced with custom color James Hardie panels, and the crew even fixed a pigeon issue in the gutters they hadn't noticed.
Our goal is simple: good workmanship, personal service and clear communication from the first visit to the final clean up.

## Services
- Siding: Siding protects your home, its foundation and everything inside, and new siding makes a big difference in how the house looks.
- Windows: Swap out old windows for high-quality, energy-efficient ones, installed with care.
- Soffit: Soffit installation on the underside of your roofline, done clean, fast and neat.
- Fascia: Fascia boards run along the lower edge of the roof and help keep water from leaking into the roof deck.
- Gutters: Gutters that move rainwater away from your home and its foundation to help avoid water damage.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Send us your name, phone and the service you're interested in, or give us a call, and we'll set up your free estimate.

Q: Is financing available?
A: Yes. Leave us your information through the financing form and we'll contact you about your online financing alternatives.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We're based on W North Ave in Elmwood Park and work with homeowners across Chicago.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Saturday 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM. We're closed Sunday.
